data.text: Kickoff for Project Anchor and the separate Anchorline stream: keep the two names cleanly separated in memory. Anchor is the maritime scheduling pilot; Anchorline is the support-line operations stream, and cross-project summaries must not mix customer, budget, vendor, or incident details.
